guidance.title: Problem framing and user outcomes
guidance.problem: The problem recurs and its cost or impact can be measured.
guidance.use_when: The problem recurs and its cost or impact can be measured.
guidance.avoid_when: The users or problem remain unknown, or a solution has already been chosen.
guidance.technique: Interview affected users, observe outcomes, and formulate falsifiable hypotheses.
tradeoffs: Surveys alone can introduce selection bias.
alternatives: Retain the simplest proven current approach
Document and accept the risk instead of adopting the pattern
guidance.evidence_strategy: Define a measurable project baseline, a falsification method and acceptance evidence.
guidance.review_trigger: new failure mode, source revision, project context change

guidance.title: Security and supply-chain controls across the lifecycle
guidance.problem: Personal information, unauthorized access, supply-chain threats or safety impacts create material risk.
guidance.use_when: Personal information, unauthorized access, supply-chain threats or safety impacts create material risk.
guidance.avoid_when: Heavy frameworks are imposed on all low-risk prototypes without assessing scope.
guidance.technique: Combine threat modeling, security requirements, verification, vulnerability triage and provenance based on risk.
tradeoffs: Controls consume resources and may affect usability; legal mandates can still apply.
Legal and industry rules may be binding for the applicable scope.
alternatives: Begin with a scoped risk register and lightweight static checks
Apply a stricter scoped agreement where regulations or certification require it
guidance.evidence_strategy: Link prioritized risks to mitigations, negative tests and post-release threat signals.
guidance.review_trigger: new threats, CVEs, regulatory changes, material data-handling changes
